# Sources and licenses

- MaleCNS v1.0 connectome tables and SWC skeletons: Janelia / FlyEM and research
  collaborators. Source: https://male-cns.janelia.org/download/ . CC BY 4.0.
  Data retained by assigned neuronal superclass, excluding explicit glia; all
  directed edges between retained neurons remain in the simulation. Graphics
  are a deterministic, decimated and quantized subset of original skeletons.
- NeuroMechFly / FlyGym anatomical meshes, rigging and neutral pose: NeLy-EPFL,
  https://github.com/NeLy-EPFL/flygym, revision
  `38c8ec61034cd59bc5ba0de20688d4a3c0000d60`. Apache 2.0; license in
  `licenses/FlyGym-Apache-2.0.txt`. Mesh units converted to millimetres; right
  geometry mirrored as in the source; neutral joint transforms exported.
  Materials, bristles and presentation animations are added by FLY.
- Doomfly full-graph LIF kernel and retention/input approach: nftechie,
  https://github.com/nftechie/doomfly, revision
  `71ecf53d78eaffaf1a57ed7b0ccf5d458abc9f33`. MIT license in
  `licenses/doomfly-MIT.txt`. `neural/kernel.cpp` is copied unchanged.
  Python integration, four-way decoder and trial learning rule are new.
- Three.js 0.180.0: https://threejs.org/ . MIT license included in
  `dist/vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt`.
- German citizenship wording and original answer order: official
  Einbürgerungstestverordnung, Anlage 1,
  https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/einbtestv/anlage_1.html .
  Secondary answer-key transcription:
  https://github.com/leben-in-deutschland/leben-in-deutschland-scrapper (MIT).
  Only original German correct-answer text is used for matching; generated
  contexts and translations are discarded. Keys are not represented as BAMF
  certified. Source-byte hashes and excluded IDs are included with the data.
- Fonts are self-hosted under `dist/fonts/` (SIL Open Font License 1.1, notices
  in `dist/fonts/OFL.txt`): Anton, Barlow Condensed, DM Sans, IBM Plex Mono and
  Source Serif 4. No page requests Google Fonts at runtime.
- Three.js post-processing addons (EffectComposer, RenderPass, ShaderPass,
  UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass and their shaders) are vendored unchanged from
  three 0.180.0 under `dist/vendor/addons/`. MIT.
- The film soundtrack is original synthesis (`tools/soundtrack.py`); no samples
  or licensed audio. Desk props, forms and all film graphics are generated by
  FLY code.

Background article: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/research/male-fruit-fly-brain-map/

No source is claimed to have demonstrated that a fly can pass this test.
